headline: Southwest Baptist concede at last and drop first points
dek: Missouri-St. Louis drew at Southwest Baptist on the first full day of conference play, and the two goals they scored are the only two the hosts have conceded all season. Southwest Baptist remain unbeaten and have seventeen goals of their own, more than any other programme.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist's seventeen goals exceed the combined total of Lincoln, McKendree, Missouri-St. Louis, Indianapolis, Illinois Springfield, Upper Iowa and William Jewell; the shape is still one side and a field, and the first side to hold them, Missouri-St. Louis, is on that list.

wire.line: Missouri-St. Louis are the first side to score against Southwest Baptist this season, and they did it twice.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches past their date carry no published result: Drury's at home to Evangel and away at Wash U, and Missouri S&T's visit to Kentucky Wesleyan. No final is missing its score.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Missouri S&T have won all three matches, scoring eight and conceding one, and six different players have scored for them; their visit to Kentucky Wesleyan still carries no result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: McKendree have won one and lost three, scoring three and conceding five; the win came at Cedarville, and their first home match of the season was lost to Quincy.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Asgrimur Vidisson has made eighteen saves for Maryville and has conceded four goals. He has kept two clean sheets, and Maryville have won two matches and lost two.

last_match.line: McKendree lost their first home match of the season; Quincy have not lost since their opening day at Wisconsin-Parkside.

next_match.line: William Jewell have yet to score this season; Missouri S&T have yet to lose.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
